title: One Last Adventure in Cusco 🇵🇪
subject: 🇵🇪 Cusco Had More Surprises Waiting for Me!
paragraphs: POSTCARDS FROM DAINYEL Take the scenic route.
I thought Machu Picchu would be the grand finale of our time in Cusco, but this city had other plans!
From riding quad bikes through the Andes and spotting flamingos to exploring ancient Inca ruins and hidden corners of the city, our final days were full of surprises.
And somehow, we even ended up in Cusco during the Pope's visit!
I've shared the whole adventure, including my favorite moments and photos, in my latest travel story .
See you on the next adventure! 🌎
See you on the scenic route, Dainyel
